flagged_issues.description: Customer contact email must be populated
flagged_issues.remediation: Apply deterministic placeholder email format (guest_<cust_id>@unregistered.internal) and enforce email validation at signup UI.

flagged_issues.description: Customer email addresses must be globally unique across profiles
flagged_issues.remediation: Apply LOWER(TRIM(email)) in ETL merge pipeline; merge duplicate customer histories into primary canonical customer UUID.

flagged_issues.description: VIP and Corporate customers must have telephone numbers
flagged_issues.remediation: Trigger automated in-app profile completion prompt for tier upgrade qualification; fall back to billing telephone record.

flagged_issues.description: US postal codes must conform to standard 5-digit or 9-digit ZIP regex
flagged_issues.remediation: Cleanse string with regex extraction r'^(\d{5})(-\d{4})?$'; integrate USPS Address Verification API at checkout.

flagged_issues.description: Product unit_price must exceed unit_cost (positive gross margin)
flagged_issues.remediation: Swap inverted cost and price attributes; notify merchant pricing team and halt automated clearance markdown rules.

flagged_issues.description: Product weight must not contain extreme anomalies (> 50kg for retail)
flagged_issues.remediation: Apply conditional conversion (weight_kg = weight_kg / 1000) when category is 'Accessories' and weight > 50kg; update freight rate quotes.

flagged_issues.description: Orders must be associated with a valid customer_id
flagged_issues.remediation: Backfill customer_id from payment gateway payer email lookup; reject order creation events lacking customer UUID in Kafka topic.

flagged_issues.description: Order currency must be standardized to ISO-4217 uppercase 'USD'
flagged_issues.remediation: Standardize ingestion to ISO-4217 3-letter currency codes via uppercase string transformation and strict enum validation.

flagged_issues.description: Order total must be free of extreme synthetic QA test amounts ($9,999,999)
flagged_issues.remediation: Exclude synthetic test account orders with flag is_test = TRUE; tag and isolate transactions exceeding 4 sigma from executive reporting.

flagged_issues.description: Discount amount must not exhibit rounding clusters of $0.01
flagged_issues.remediation: Absorb rounding fractions into payment processor fee account; eliminate spurious $0.01 promotional records.

flagged_issues.description: Cancelled orders must not have conflicting Delivered status in shipments
flagged_issues.remediation: Reconcile order state to 'Return_Pending'; auto-generate prepaid return label and trigger customer returns notification.

flagged_issues.description: Order items product_id must exist in active product catalog master
flagged_issues.remediation: Implement foreign key constraint with RESTRICT ON DELETE; restore soft-deleted product records with 'Archived' status.

flagged_issues.description: Item quantity must be strictly positive (no negative returns in sales ledger)
flagged_issues.remediation: Route negative adjustments to dedicated fct_returns table; enforce CHECK (quantity > 0) constraint in sales transaction schema.

flagged_issues.description: Discount rate must be bounded between 0% and 100% (0.0 to 1.0)
flagged_issues.remediation: Cap discount rate at 1.0 (or max permissible promotional threshold 0.70); recalculate line total item price.

flagged_issues.description: Settled payments with status 'Success' must have gateway transaction ID
flagged_issues.remediation: Require accounting clearing reference number for manual B2B transactions; enforce non-null constraint at payment service layer.

flagged_issues.description: Settled payment amount must reconcile identically with order total
flagged_issues.remediation: Execute automated differential ledger refund or invoice adjustment; implement two-phase commit on cart checkout settlement.

flagged_issues.description: Shipments marked 'Delivered' must record delivered_date timestamp
flagged_issues.remediation: Extract delivery timestamp from carrier tracking raw payload; patch webhook parser to handle carrier-specific status date schemas.

flagged_issues.description: Temporal causality: shipped_date must occur chronologically after order_date
flagged_issues.remediation: Normalize all timestamp ingestions to UTC at API gateway; flag and recalculate shipment lead times with timezone offsets.

flagged_issues.description: Inventory stock records must define an active reorder_point threshold
flagged_issues.remediation: Default reorder point to category median safety stock formula (2 * lead_time_days * avg_daily_sales) upon SKU activation.

flagged_issues.description: Warehouse location must not be a zero-variance degenerate constant ('WH-DEFAULT')
flagged_issues.remediation: Reprocess inventory snapshots using location cross-reference table; re-enable multi-facility inventory allocation.

flagged_issues.description: Interaction timestamps must not be set to future dates
flagged_issues.remediation: Overwrite client-provided timestamp with server-side database CURRENT_TIMESTAMP upon ticket creation.

flagged_issues.description: CSAT rating scores must fall strictly within the 1 to 5 scale
flagged_issues.remediation: Rescale 10-point NPS scores to 5-star metric: CEIL(nps_score / 2.0); create distinct columns for NPS vs CSAT.

flagged_issues.description: Ticket resolution time must not have idle extreme outliers (> 48 hours / 2880 mins)
flagged_issues.remediation: Deduct paused customer-wait time from total duration; implement automated 72-hour ticket auto-close trigger.
